guides.name: TV turns on but the screen stays black (safe checks)
aliases: tv turns on but no picture
tv has sound but no picture
steps: Press Home or Menu on the remote. If a menu shows, the screen works.
If nothing happens, point the remote at a phone camera and press Power.
No light on the phone screen? Put fresh batteries in the remote and try again.
Press Input or Source and choose the input your box is plugged into.
Make sure the cable box, streaming stick or game console is turned on.
Unplug each video cable and push it back in firmly, at both ends.
Turn off the TV and the box, then unplug both from the wall.
Wait one full minute, plug them back in, and turn them on.
Still black? Try a different HDMI port on the TV, or a different HDMI cable.
safety: Never open the back of the TV. There is high voltage inside and nothing you can fix.
Unplug by pulling the plug, not the cord, and never with wet hands.
stopIf: You hear strange sounds or smell burning. Unplug it and call for service.
The screen is cracked or the TV was dropped.
There is still no picture from any input or device. The TV needs service.

guides.name: Wi-Fi or internet stopped working at home
steps: Check a second phone or tablet. If only one device is offline, restart that one.
Make sure the device's Wi-Fi is turned on and joined to your home network.
Push every cable firmly into the modem, the router and the wall.
One box only? Unplug its power cord, wait one minute, and plug it back in.
Two boxes? Unplug the power cords from both the modem and the router.
Wait two minutes, then plug in only the modem.
Wait about five minutes, until the modem's lights stay steady.
Now plug in the router. Give it a few minutes to connect.
Wi-Fi weak in one room? Move closer to the router and try again.
safety: Restart only. Do not hold the Reset button; it erases your Wi-Fi name and password.
If your home phone runs through the modem, it cannot call 911 until the box is back online.
stopIf: Your internet company's app or website shows an outage. Restarting won't help; wait it out.
The modem's lights never settle, or a light stays red. Call your internet company.
Still no internet and no outage reported? Call your internet company.
